supply_sprint.t: Supply sprint: {missing} more listings to reach 300
supply_sprint.d: Only {live} live listings. 100 personal messages a day to brokers and owners (warm + cold), starting with: {areas}. Offer the Founding Partner deal: free, live within 48 hours.

go_live.d: {demo_share} of live listings are demo. Once real listings cover the main areas, switch off demo mode (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) so every number here is real.

fill_zero_results.d: Each empty search is a renter we lost. Recruit listings in: {areas}.

ask_bills.t: Ask publishers for bills: only {share} report them
ask_bills.d: Real monthly cost (generator + water) is the dream outcome renters want. Message publishers to fill electricity and water in their listings.

enter_area_facts.t: Enter area facts ({share} of listings covered)
enter_area_facts.d: Safety, thefts, quiet and garbage raise trust. Start with the most-searched areas without facts: {areas}.

confirm_reminders.d: Ask publishers to confirm availability (dashboard button). Stale listings kill trust.

more_photos.d: Photos raise perceived likelihood. Offer free professional photos to Founding Partners' best flats.

answer_top_wishes.t: Renters ask for things our listings don't say
answer_top_wishes.d: Top unanswered wishes: {wishes}. Ask publishers to fill those fields.

call_quiet_listings.d: Many visitors, no contact: likely price, photos or missing info. Call the owners (list on the dashboard tab).

improve_conversion.d: Improve the top listings: price vs area median, photos, bills and area facts filled.

start_content.d: Start daily Arabic content (reels: 'what $700 rents in Hamra', generator bills, area cards) pointing to a specific search.

better_prompts.d: People type vague queries. Add more example prompts and categories on the home page.

feature_new_listings.t: New listings wait {hours} h for a first inquiry
feature_new_listings.d: Feature new listings in the home rows for their first week.

start_paid_ads.d: Organic works. Test a small Meta budget with the 2 best reels, measuring cost per inquiry.

win_back_publishers.t: Only {rate} of publishers are still active after 60 days
win_back_publishers.d: Call inactive publishers, send them their stats, and ask what's missing.

growth.noSteps: Nothing urgent: keep doing more of what works.

bm.canvasHint: How 2ajar creates, delivers and captures value.

i: Service providers: movers, solar, generators, internet
Recruit and onboard listings (do it for them)
Curate area facts (safety, noise, garbage, floods)
Renters: find a flat by saying what you need, with real bills and area facts
No surprises: generator, water, safety known before visiting
Brokers: serious, pre-informed inquiries; free setup in 48 h
Rent anything from an hour to years
Founding Partners: personal onboarding and monthly reports
Instagram / TikTok reels, SEO area pages
Warm and cold outreach to brokers
Renters in Beirut & Mount Lebanon (locals, students, expats)
Later: short-stay commission, rent index reports

bm.moneyHint: Free during the founding period. Start charging only after brokers see value in their stats. Pricing is the owner's decision (Q1); numbers below are starting assumptions for the Lebanese market.

streams.d: Pay to appear first in the area's home row and in search for 7 days. Simple, one-off, works for owners and brokers.
Free: up to 5 live listings. Pro: unlimited listings, stats and monthly report, verified badge, CSV import, 2 boosts/month.
Several agents under one agency, shared dashboard and leads, agency page.
Renters who just found a flat need movers, internet, solar or a generator subscription. Recommend vetted partners, earn a referral fee. Fits 2ajar's living-cost data.
streams.p: e.g. 5–10% or a fixed fee per job

streams.d: Paid owner verification visit and professional photo shoot.
streams.when: Anytime; also a Founding Partner bonus

streams.d: A % on chalet and day-use bookings once online booking exists (no calendar for now).
Anonymous, aggregated rent and living-cost reports for banks, NGOs and developers. Never personal data.

bm.avoid: Avoid early: charging renters, pay-per-lead (hard to verify, invites disputes), banner ads (hurt trust).
bm.payments: Payments in Lebanon (Q7): start with invoices paid by Whish Money, OMT, bank transfer or cash in USD; add card payments later.
bm.simHint: Starts from today's real numbers; change the assumptions to see monthly revenue.
bm.simNote: Assumptions, not forecasts. Today's base: {publishers} active publishers, {listings} live listings, {inquiries} inquiries/week.
